hero.subheadline: Premium guided and self-guided walking tours across Portugal's most extraordinary landscapes.

intro.label: About Us
intro.title:
Born from the territory.
Operating with purpose.
intro.body: Portugal NTN spent 12 years building and structuring walking trails across northern and northeastern Portugal. Now we operate them. Every programme we offer is a programme we designed, certified, and know by heart.
intro.body2: Every programme we sell was designed, waymarked and certified by us. We do not resell other people's routes: the team that welcomes you in Portugal is the same one that mapped the trail.

whyus.label: The NTN difference
whyus.title: Why walk with us
whyus.value1Desc: We adapt every programme to the group's needs.
whyus.value2Desc: Our team coordinates the full travel logistics.
whyus.value3Desc: Committed to the people and the territory.
whyus.value4Desc: We know every trail because we built them.
whyus.value5Desc: Genuine products from the communities we serve.
whyus.value6Desc: We operate locally to maximise the experience.

destinations.label: Where We Operate
destinations.title:
Where we walk,
we are local.
destinations.body: We operate in the regions we know best, from the Douro to the mountains of Trás-os-Montes, from Gerês to the Algarve. Every destination is territory where we have roots.

sustainability.label: Our Commitment
sustainability.title:
Walking that
gives back
sustainability.body: Every step supports local communities, preserves cultural heritage, and funds the maintenance of the trails we helped create. Sustainability is not a tag. It is our origin story.

contact.label: Get in touch
contact.title: Let's design your walk.
contact.body: Tell us your dates, how many you are and the pace you are looking for. We reply within 24 hours with a tailored proposal, written by the people who know the ground.

blog.label: Trail Journal
blog.title: Stories from the territory
blog.body: Field notes, guides and behind-the-scenes from those who walk and operate Portugal's trails.

sustainablePage.heroTitle:
Walking leaves
a mark. Ours is
a positive one.
sustainablePage.heroBody: We operate nature tourism with a real commitment: every programme contributes to preserving the territories, developing local communities and valuing heritage.
sustainablePage.p1Body: Visiting is not enough. We believe in tourism that gives back more than it takes. That is why we built routes that respect nature's pace, support the local economy and preserve the memory of places.
sustainablePage.area1Body: Trails designed to minimise environmental impact and protect the biodiversity of the regions where we operate.
sustainablePage.area2Body: Every journey generates value for the accommodations, restaurants and producers of the communities we cross.
sustainablePage.area3Body: We work with local guides, hosts and partners, keeping the traditions and knowledge of the territory alive.
sustainablePage.area4Body: We value villages, ancient paths and cultural legacy, interpreting them for those who visit us.
sustainablePage.ctaBody: Talk to our team and discover how we craft responsible, memorable walking experiences.

portal.intro: PORTUGALNTN is a tourism and travel company that delivers distinctive experiences, in safe yet challenging environments, where heritage and local people take the leading role. We value genuineness and authenticity, in tune with local communities and partners, generating lasting value for the territory, grounded in respect for and preservation of tangible and intangible heritage.

aboutPage.heroTitle:
Walking specialists
who know the ground
beneath your feet
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Portugal NTN is a tourism and travel company offering distinctive experiences in safe yet challenging environments, where people and places take the leading role.
aboutPage.companyTitle: Genuine Portugal, at a human pace
aboutPage.companyBody1: We design small-group and tailor-made programs around adventure, culture and gastronomy, built on privileged contact with the most genuine side of Portugal, in harmony with local communities and a sustainable approach to the territory.
aboutPage.companyBody2: Our structured walking programs run from 1 to 15 days, in guided and self-guided formats, across northern Portugal, Lisbon and the Algarve.
aboutPage.teamBody1: Our team brings together people with military training and operational experience across several countries. Our guides are certified by the National School of Mountaineering in hiking, rope work and hiking instruction.
aboutPage.teamBody2: Safety, customer satisfaction and the commitment of our people are at the heart of how we work.
aboutPage.conductTitle: How we walk, and why it matters
aboutPage.conduct1Body: We work in partnership with local people and non-profit organisations, supporting local economies and keeping every program in tune with local traditions and culture.
aboutPage.conduct2Body: We promote the territory in a sustainable way, with social and environmental responsibility, preserving the natural and cultural heritage that makes each route unique.
aboutPage.conduct3Body: Safety guides every decision. We assess conditions on the ground, follow strict standards and keep improving based on our guests' feedback.
aboutPage.ctaBody: Explore our programmes or learn how we operate, sustainably and with purpose.
aboutPage.consultingTitle:
We built the territory.
Now we operate it.
aboutPage.consultingBody: Before creating any walking program, Portugal NTN spent 12 years structuring, signing and certifying pedestrian trails, Cyclin' Portugal Centres and Trail Running Centres across northern and northeastern Portugal. That fieldwork is at the root of every Walking program we offer.

faqPage.intro: Everything you need to know before you walk with us, from booking and payments to what to pack and how our guides support you.
faqPage.ctaBody: Tell us about your group and your dates, and our team will reply within 24 hours.

gradingPage.intro: Every programme carries a difficulty grade so you know what to expect before you set off. The scale runs from very easy to very difficult, based on distance, elevation gain and terrain.

hero.title: Exclusive
hero.bracket: Designed for one group at a time
hero.lead: Private walking journeys through the north and northeast of Portugal, built route by route for agencies and operators who are asked for something a catalogue does not hold.

manifesto.statement: We do not sell a catalogue. We design the journey, <accent>then we walk it ourselves</accent>.
manifesto.p1: Every route in this collection was surveyed on foot, waymarked and certified by the team that operates it. Nothing is subcontracted to a name you have never met, and nothing is sold before it has been walked in the season your client will walk it.
manifesto.p2: That is why the itineraries here are not fixed. A programme can be lengthened, softened, moved to another month or rebuilt around a single interest, and the operation on the ground stays with the same people.

journeys.title: Signature journeys
journeys.lead: Eight days is the form we believe in: long enough for a region to change around the group, short enough to stay demanding. Each one has a public version. These are not it.

itinerary.lead: Eight days along the Douro terraces, from Peso da Régua to Pinhão, with the estates opened privately for the group.
itinerary.note: Route drawn for illustration. Full day by day, accommodation and NET conditions in the dossier.

dayTours.title: A single day, fully held
dayTours.lead: For programmes that need one extraordinary day inserted into a longer stay. Same guides, same access, same table.

operators.title: How we work with the trade

one.title: Built to order
one.text: Send the brief and the dates. We come back with a route, a rhythm and a table, not with a page from a catalogue.

two.title: Operated by us
two.text: Design, waymarking, guiding and support on the ground are ours. One counterpart from the first email to the last transfer.

three.title: White label
three.text: The programme can travel under your brand, with your documents and your voice. Our name appears only if you want it to.

four.title: NET conditions
four.text: Trade rates, allotments and cancellation terms are set out in the dossier, per programme and per season.
